reason: The moss slime is real low-res pixel art: hard shading bands, a varied dark outline, hand-placed moss, pebble and sprout detail and a clear silhouette, though its interior texture is noisier and less cleanly clustered than the wolves'. It faces right, idle_a/b/c differ visibly, attack lunges right and differs from hit, dead is a flattened defeated puddle and nothing is clipped; the only weak point is hit (cell 8), which reads mainly as a wince and squash with only a slight lean to the left.
